Hi Sanjay — thanks for the materials and summary. A couple quick asks so we can activate your vendor record and generate POs: 

- Please confirm the "legal entity" field exactly as you want it in our vendor master. We need the formal registered name for contracts and 1099/W-9 reconciliation.
- Confirm AP email for invoices and whether Brightline will accept e-invoices (Peppol/Coupa) or only PDF emailed invoices.
- For ACH, finance requires either a bank letter or a voided check. If you can provide either, we can add ACH remit (preferred).

I attached our vendor master template; please fill the yellow fields and return it. Once we have the filled form + bank confirmation + W-9, I'll route to Finance for activation.

Redwood invoice requirements (short):
- All invoices must reference a Redwood PO number to be paid.
- Remit to address must match vendor master entry.
- Net 30 unless otherwise negotiated in contract.

Laura (Legal) — can you flag if we need any additional entity documentation for the contract team?

Thanks,
Vanessa Ortiz
Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
